title: Apartment Design 120 m² in London, modern classic
description: 120 m² modern classic apartment in London: interior design, 3D visualization, technical drawings, custom furniture and turnkey renovation.
h1: Modern Classic apartment interior design in London, furniture and turnkey renovation, 120 m²

blocks.text: Modern Classic apartment interior design in London, furniture and turnkey renovation, 120 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN designed and delivered a project for a 120 m² apartment in London, United Kingdom: interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture, and a turnkey renovation.
The interior is designed in a contemporary classic style (Modern Classic): classic proportions and decorative elements are combined with a modern layout, clean forms, and several lighting scenarios.
The project included the living room, bedroom, kitchen with built-in appliances, walk-in closets, entrance hall, bathroom, and storage systems.
The kitchen, built-in wardrobes, walk-in closets, shelving, and storage systems were custom-made as part of the overall interior concept.

Before work began, a detailed cost estimate was prepared covering construction and finishing work, materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures, and lighting. A turnkey renovation of the apartment in London was then carried out based on the technical documentation.
Below are 3D visualizations of the project and photos of the finished apartment with its custom-made furniture.
